name: devin
label: Devin CLI
description: Cognition's autonomous software engineer, run headless over the Agent Client Protocol (ACP)

check_ready.not_ready_message: Devin is installed but not signed in — run: devin auth login (or set WINDSURF_API_KEY / DEVIN_API_KEY for this agent)

env_config.name: WINDSURF_API_KEY
env_config.description: API key Devin's ACP server reads automatically (leave blank if you have run `devin auth login` on this machine)

env_config.name: DEVIN_API_KEY
env_config.description: Alternate API key variable this agent also checks for the ACP `authenticate` fallback

env_config.name: DEVIN_MODEL
env_config.description: Model id passed to `devin acp --model` (leave blank for Devin's own default; fuzzy names like "opus" are accepted)

env_config.name: DEVIN_PERMISSION_MODE
env_config.description: How this agent auto-answers Devin's ACP permission requests (nobody is attached to approve them interactively): smart (default — approves once, never remembers, and narrates riskier approvals to the channel), accept-edits (auto-approves file edits, narrates everything else), dangerous/yolo/bypass (approves everything silently), autonomous (like bypass, and also passes --sandbox)

tagline: The autonomous software engineer, in your workspace.
